en.title: Total Length of the Union of Closed Process Intervals
en.description:
Each process runs during the integer closed interval [start[i],end[i]]. Find the number of integer moments at which at least one process is running. The source statement body is truncated; the original example explicitly merges overlapping intervals into [1,6], counting 6, then adds [8,10], counting 3, and the union-length rule is recovered from that explanation.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric constraints are explicitly marked as this site's additions.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of start end. Full original bounds: 1≤n≤200000, 1≤start≤end≤10^9.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 9; 1; 10. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Sort the intervals by left end and maintain the current merged interval; when a new segment does not intersect it, settle the old segment's length, otherwise extend the right end.
